blocking_issues.title: Worktree isolation breaks cross-agent anchor reads
blocking_issues.detail: Each agent runs in an isolated Docker container with its own worktree. Agent A cannot read Agent B's .egg-state/agent-anchors/ files. The spec assumes filesystem-level cross-agent reads ('Read access is unrestricted'), but this is architecturally impossible. Contracts solve this via gateway/contract_api.py. Anchors need equivalent treatment.
blocking_issues.fix: Add 'Storage Architecture' section. Recommend: agent writes own anchor locally, orchestrator service syncs to shared state. Cross-agent reads go through egg-orch CLI or gateway API.

blocking_issues.title: Coordinator agent cannot write team anchors
blocking_issues.detail: CLAUDE.md states coordinator has 'no repository access.' The spec proposes coordinator maintains team anchors, but it physically cannot write files.
blocking_issues.fix: Either (a) add egg-orch anchor team-update command that delegates to orchestrator service, or (b) assign team anchor ownership to integrator role, or (c) orchestrator service auto-generates team anchor from individual agent anchors.

blocking_issues.title: Phase file restrictions missing agent-anchors path
blocking_issues.detail: gateway/phase_filter.py default restrictions don't include .egg-state/agent-anchors/* in any phase's allowed patterns. During implement phase, .egg-state/* is blocked except agent-outputs and checkpoints.
blocking_issues.fix: Explicitly state that .egg-state/agent-anchors/* must be added to allowed_patterns for all phases.

concerns.title: Permanent context cost not acknowledged
concerns.detail: v1 always-inject means ~1,800 tokens on every API call, not just post-compaction. Should quantify total session cost.

concerns.title: agent_id format undefined
concerns.detail: No generation scheme defined. Role-based collides on retries. Recommend {role}-{container_id_short}.

concerns.title: CLI lacks batch/atomic update mode
concerns.detail: Common update patterns require multiple sequential read-validate-write cycles. Should support multi-field atomic updates.

concerns.title: Terminology: 'git commit hook' should be 'phase_filter extension'
concerns.detail: Gateway doesn't use git hooks — it intercepts at HTTP proxy layer.

strengths: Schema design is concrete with realistic size budgets and per-section breakdown
Hybrid update mechanism correctly balances self-report and observed state
All dependencies correctly classified as soft — enables independent implementation
Acceptance criteria are testable with clear verification methods
Risk assessment covers key concerns with practical mitigations
Good precedent analysis of consensus_wrapper.py recovery mechanism
recommendation: Resolve three blocking issues (worktree isolation, coordinator access, phase filter gaps) and spec is ready for planning. Concerns can be resolved during planning phase.
